kari: Heads-up: small but consistent RTTF regression on v2.7-int4 in the longcode slice (>=1500 tokens). ~1.7% EM down vs v2.6.

hassan: Which metric set? EM only or also token-perplexity?

kari: EM + last-token entropy up ~4%. Perplexity up ~1.1%. Shadow window ~22k longctx requests.

maria: Any head diffs? Layers?

quant-bot: quick-scan: elevated KL in heads [9,14] and slight scale shift in layernorm at layers 10..12 on int4 quant path.

hassan: Is this hitting auto-fallback? gatebook rule: abs EM delta >=2.0% OR p<0.01 on N>=10k triggers. We're below 2% but p~0.02.

kari: I ran a paired bootstrap; p=0.018. Borderline. Suggest we run a 40k seeded run focused on code-completion with varied beam sizes.
maria: Hold ramps until seeded run completes. ops-bot, can you pin canary at 0%?

ops-bot: @maria canary promotion for v2.7-int4 blocked. Current canary remains v2.6.

hassan: Also enable KV warmstart toggle for the seeded run to see cache effects.

kari: Seed job started id=seed-1713456789 n=40,000. Will upload artifacts to s3 when done.

quant-bot: Reminder: consider recalibrating quant scales for attention projection matrices; small shifts can accumulate on long prefixes.

maria: Preliminary seeded results: n=40k, EM v2.6=36.2% vs v2.7=34.6% (abs delta 1.6%, p=0.004). Entropy and KL confirm earlier signal.

hassan: P-value tightened because of larger N. Given p<0.005 on a critical slice, recommend soft rollback and ticket.

maria: Agreed. Opened ML-4302. ops-bot, initiate soft rollback.

ops-bot: Rolling back canary int4 -> v2.6 across canary pools. ETA ~6 minutes. Notifying oncall.

deploy-bot: rollback job RB-1713456789 created. Canary pinned to v2.6.

kari: Follow-ups for quant team: small-scale calibrate for heads [9,14], run beam-size sensitivity tests, and add per-head KL alert to gatebook.

maria: I'll draft gatebook edits: require seeded N>=20k for longctx critical slices and p<0.005 for auto-fallback.

hassan: Good. Closing loop: rollback done, ticket ML-4302 opened.

kari: End thread.
